pages.name: Caro-Kann Exchange Variation, Rubinstein, 7.Qb3 Qd7
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed g4 onto the bishop's square; plan 4 developed a c8-bishop that is already on g4. Rewrote overview and plans 1 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann Exchange Variation, Rubinstein, 7.Qb3 Qd7
pages.notes: The overview said White exchanged the light-squared bishop and gave up the bishop pair (it was Bf4xd6 between dark-squared bishops); plan 1 gave White a minority attack through the b3-queen; plan 3 developed a dark-squared bishop already traded; plan 4 targeted an e4-pawn that isn't there. Rewrote overview and plans 1, 3 and 4.

pages.name: Caro-Kann: Exchange, Rubinstein, 6...Bg4
pages.notes: Plan 3 pushed g4 onto the bishop's square; plan 4 said the trade itself damages White's structure; plan 2 named White's Qb3 as a move in Black's plan. Rewrote plans 2-4; British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann: Exchange, Rubinstein, 7.Qb3 Qc8
pages.notes: Plan 1 gave White a minority attack through the queen on b3. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann: Panov-Botvinnik, 4...e6
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed d4-d5 into Black's d5-pawn; plan 2 placed ...Nd5 on Black's own pawn. Rewrote both plans; British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann: Panov-Botvinnik, 5...Nc6 6.Bg5 dxc4
pages.notes: Plan 1 read e5 as a move; plan 4 called the c-file semi-open; plans 3 and 4 wrote castling as 0-0. Rewrote plans 1, 3 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann: Panov-Botvinnik, 5...Nc6 6.cxd5 Nxd5
pages.notes: Plan 3 pushed d4-d5 into the d5-knight; plan 1 routed Nf3-e5 with no knight on f3. Rewrote plans 1 and 3; British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann: Panov-Botvinnik, 5...Nc6 6.Nf3
pages.notes: Plan 1 used d5 as a White outpost where Black's pawn stands; plan 3 pushed d4-d5 into it. Rewrote plans 1 and 3; British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann: Panov-Botvinnik, 5...Nc6 6.Nf3 Bg4: Main Line
pages.notes: Plan 1 played Ba3 through the b2-pawn and Qh3 through the c3-knight and missed the critical 10.Qxb7; plan 2 suggested long castling. Rewrote plans 1 and 2; British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann: Panov-Botvinnik, 5...Nc6, Normal Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed d4-d5 into Black's d5-pawn and wrote the bishop squares as e2/d3. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling.
